title: Board Indirect Handles
description: Introduce board indirect handles: in normal LOD, hide normal handles unless exactly one node is selected; show a ring of scaled-up handles around selected node above other nodes; clicking a source ring handle starts a wire; dropping the wire on a target node shows that target node's ring; selecting a target handle creates the edge, otherwise the wire stops. Validate behavior with existing board tests/runtime checks where feasible.
summary: Indirect-connect ghost rings now omit handles that already have an incident edge: append_indirect_handle_ring skips drawing them and resolve_hit_world skips them before other picks. Added handle_eligible_indirect_connect_ring helper and host_tests board_host_indirect_ring_resolve_skips_connected_handles with link_test_scene_node_a_two_handles_one_busy.
